description.en: AndroidDaily evaluates mobile GUI agents on 350 daily-use tasks across 94 closed-source Android applications. Automatic scoring is based on a three-tiered guideline system (operational obligations, output quality, negative constraints), with step-level diagnostic judgments.

evidence.snippet: To bridge this gap, we introduce AndroidDaily, a large-scale benchmark comprising 350 realistic daily-use tasks across 94 high-frequency Android applications spanning transportation, shopping, local services, entertainment, content creation, social media, and everyday utilities.

claire_radar.motivation: The rapid development of GUI foundation models and mobile GUI agents has spurred numerous evaluation benchmarks, yet most rely on simulated environments or open-source applications, leaving real-world closed-source applications largely unevaluated.
claire_radar.name: AndroidDaily

claire_radar.paperTitle: AndroidDaily: A Verifiable Benchmark for Mobile GUI Agents on Real-World Closed-Source Applications

source.title: AndroidDaily: A Verifiable Benchmark for Mobile GUI Agents on Real-World Closed-Source Applications

claire_radar.whyItMatters: Fills evaluation gap for real-world closed-source apps where internal states are unavailable, providing a verifiable scoring method based on observable guidelines. Useful for assessing practical deployment of GUI agents.
